cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've copied your confident message: 'I'll handle Thursday.' Put your name under it. I only took your bins out once.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That message was about dinner. The bins go on Friday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, prepare the evening before. Send it to the neighbours with bins in the first line, so they know you're taking over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stay in the group until I know which bin goes out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Ask them which one, then tell them you'll put it out. I'll wait for that message before I leave.

reason: Replace detachable certainty with a specific copied misunderstanding that changes how A delays, seeks apology or assent, transfers responsibility, or retrieves a lost plan.
